X3 –‑5Ω‑‑ N_d1 –‑10Ω‑‑ N_d2 –‑15Ω‑‑ N_d3 –‑20Ω‑‑ B

Thus there are four resistors, labeled left‑to‑right (from X3 to B) as R1‑R4 with the values above. The required JSON describing the topology is prepared.</thought>
